visualCharacteristics.purpose: equal-width text columns (heading, text, optional links), 2-4 across

contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per column (heading, text, optional links); optional first row with a single image-only cell becomes the section background; Glance option renders each column as a white fact card; Narrow option (or a 'narrow' section style) uses 4-up centred slots; overflowing columns (always on mobile) become a carousel
